title: The draft-PR guard skips PR-create words that sit inside a heredoc or string
why:
Incident, triage 2026-11-07 about 14:52 CST: rule draft-pr refused a Bash call because the words of a PR-create command sat inside a Python heredoc string (roadmap step text), not a real command. LANE 20:29 CST Nov 14 (coordinator 20:27): lane heredoc-text-guards started (session id unread by triage); it measures the three guards' false alarms first (counts gh-write 3, draft-pr 2, process-args 1; minutes unmeasured), one reader for heredoc text in guard_core, a real command stays refused, red first, net-value test at round 3. LANE 20:31 CST Nov 14 (coordinator 20:29): lane heredoc-text-guards is session_013NEJL1tcKPHXbDyDsoxvPR. 00:27 CST Nov 15 (coordinator message 00:28 CST, relayed): lane heredoc-text-guards, guard_core.py options a, b, c: the lane resends its options and the coordinator picks the recommended one next. coordinator's pick under the owner's 20:18 words, not the owner's; undoable once taken; no pick yet.

00:30 CST Nov 15 PICK (coordinator's pick under the owner's 20:18 CST Nov 14 words, not the owner's; undoable): heredoc-text-guards, option a: narrow to the four red forms; close the incident steps as "not reproducible on main, pinned green" on the lane's measurement of about 30 probes; the lane's hand-in names the holes it saw on main and the coordinator sends them as notes. NOT closed here: closing comes with the lane's hand-in. The coordinator named three incident steps and gave two (draft-pr-guard-heredoc, gh-write-heredoc-text-false-alarm); four steps share lane session_013NEJL1tcKPHXbDyDsoxvPR (those two plus heredoc-keep-gap-cases and process-args-heredoc-probe), so which is the third is not known to triage; noted on all four. 00:35 CST Nov 15 (coordinator message 00:34 CST, relayed): the coordinator cannot name the third and will not guess; nothing is marked "not reproducible on main, pinned green" until the lane's hand-in lands and names the steps it pinned green; the coordinator then sends triage that list.

[00:16 CST Nov 16, triage] Full note before the trim to 200 words (goal item 6, option b):
Coordinator 14:53 CST: a fix, not a note. Red case first: a heredoc that holds the words passes, a real PR create with no draft flag still refuses. Guard change, full review rounds. Cause (lane, about 14:55 CST): strip_heredoc_bodies in hooks/guard_core.py, the one heredoc home, keeps every heredoc body in view when any heredoc-written file is run in the same command, so a data body is read as shell. The fix narrows that home, so it touches every rule that reads heredocs, not draft-pr alone. Topic guard-false-alarms.
